text_en: Then his son Judas, who was called Maccabeus, took command in his place.
text_cn: 他的儿子犹大又名玛加伯的，接了他的位。

text_en: All his brothers and all who had joined his father helped him; they gladly fought for Israel.
text_cn: 他的众兄弟及附和他父亲的人，都来辅佐他，大家都奋勇为以色列作战。

text_en: He extended the glory of his people. Like a giant he put on his breastplate; he bound on his armor of war and waged battles, protecting the camp by his sword.
text_cn: 他增加了自己百姓的光荣，身披甲胄，状似英雄，腰佩兵器，领军作战，持刀护阵，

text_en: He was like a lion in his deeds, like a lion’s cub roaring for prey.
text_cn: 着手行事有如壮狮，捕猎怒号好似幼狮。

text_en: He searched out and pursued those who broke the law; he burned those who troubled his people.
text_cn: 把歹徒搜查追捕，将加害百姓者，以火焚烧。

text_en: Lawbreakers shrank back for fear of him; all the evildoers were confounded; and deliverance prospered by his hand.
text_cn: 于是违法歹徒，不寒而栗；作恶匪类，惊惶失措；救国大业，赖其成功。

text_en: He embittered many kings, but he made Jacob glad by his deeds, and his memory is blessed forever.
text_cn: 他使许多君王苦恼，行事却使雅各伯欢乐，因为他集合了四散的人。

text_en: He went through the cities of Judah; he destroyed the ungodly out of the land; thus he turned away wrath from Israel.
text_cn: 他出巡犹太各城，将城中恶徒铲除，从以色列挽回圣怒。

text_en: He was renowned to the ends of the earth; he gathered in those who were perishing.
text_cn: 他的声名遍传地极，他的纪念永受赞美。

text_en: Apollonius now gathered together Gentiles and a large force from Samaria to fight against Israel.
text_cn: 阿波罗尼调集异民， 又从撒玛黎雅调来一支劲旅，要进攻以色列。

text_en: When Judas learned of it, he went out to meet him, and he defeated and killed him. Many were wounded and fell, and the rest fled.
text_cn: 犹大一听说，就出兵迎击，将阿波罗尼杀死，敌方伤亡甚众，残敌四散逃命，

text_en: Then they seized their spoils; and Judas took the sword of Apollonius, and used it in battle the rest of his life.
text_cn: 犹太人夺得了许多物资；犹大取了阿波罗尼的宝剑，一生用来作战。

text_en: When Seron, the commander of the Syrian army, heard that Judas had gathered a large company, including a body of faithful soldiers who stayed with him and went out to battle,
text_cn: 叙利亚的军长色龙，听说犹大召集了很多军民，号召一伙忠诚的犹太人，随他前往作战，

text_en: he said, “I will make a name for myself and win honor in the kingdom. I will make war on Judas and his companions, who scorn the king’s command. ”
text_cn: 就说：“我要成名，在国内受光荣，要战胜犹大和跟随他而轻视王命的人。”

text_en: Once again a strong army of godless men went up with him to help him, to take vengeance on the Israelites.
text_cn: 他于是出征，率领一支强大而凶横（hèng）军队，来向以色列子民复仇。

text_en: When he approached the ascent of Beth-horon, Judas went out to meet him with a small company.
text_cn: 当他行近贝特曷龙山坡时， 犹大带着一小队兵，前去迎击。

text_en: But when they saw the army coming to meet them, they said to Judas, “How can we, few as we are, fight against so great and so strong a multitude? And we are faint, for we have eaten nothing today. ”
text_cn: 他们一见大军迎面而来，便向犹大说：“我们人数少，怎能攻打这么众多，强大有力的敌人呢？何况我们今天还未用饭，疲乏无力呢！”

text_en: Judas replied, “It is easy for many to be hemmed in by few, for in the sight of Heaven there is no difference between saving by many or by few.
text_cn: 犹大回答说：“多数人困在少数人手里，是容易的事；用多数或用少数人施救，为上天没有区别。

text_en: It is not on the size of the army that victory in battle depends, but strength comes from Heaven.
text_cn: 因为战争的胜利，不在乎军队的多寡，而在乎由天而来力量。

text_en: They come against us in great insolence and lawlessness to destroy us and our wives and our children, and to despoil us;
text_cn: 他们来攻打我们，蛮横傲慢，无法无天，原为铲除我们和我们的妻子儿女，前来洗劫抢掠。

text_en: but we fight for our lives and our laws.
text_cn: 但是，我们是为保护性命和法律而战；

text_en: He himself will crush them before us; as for you, do not be afraid of them. ”
text_cn: 因此，天主必会亲自在我们面前粉碎他们；所以千万不要害怕！”

text_en: When he finished speaking, he rushed suddenly against Seron and his army, and they were crushed before him.
text_cn: 他一说完这话，便突然出击，色龙与他的军队不支败退。

text_en: They pursued them down the descent of Beth-horon to the plain; eight hundred of them fell, and the rest fled into the land of the Philistines.
text_cn: 犹大从贝特曷龙山坡，一直追到平原。敌人阵亡的约有八百，余下的都逃到培肋舍特人的地方去了。

text_en: Then Judas and his brothers began to be feared, and terror fell on the Gentiles all around them.
text_cn: 从此，众人对犹大和他的兄弟都害怕起来，四周的异民也都为之震惊。

text_en: His fame reached the king, and the Gentiles talked of the battles of Judas.
text_cn: 犹大的名声传到了君王那里，异民都称述他的战功。

text_en: When King Antiochus heard these reports, he was greatly angered; and he sent and gathered all the forces of his kingdom, a very strong army.
text_cn: 安提约古王一听这消息，心中大怒，下令调集全国军队，编成强有力的大军。

text_en: He opened his coffers and gave a year’s pay to his forces, and ordered them to be ready for any need.
text_cn: 打开库房，给军队发了一年的军饷，且嘱咐他们准备应变。

text_en: Then he saw that the money in the treasury was exhausted, and that the revenues from the country were small because of the dissension and disaster that he had caused in the land by abolishing the laws that had existed from the earliest days.
text_cn: 当时他也发觉国库银钱短绌（chù），又因废弃旧制，国内混乱，各地税收大减。

text_en: He feared that he might not have such funds as he had before for his expenses and for the gifts that he used to give more lavishly than preceding kings.
text_cn: 他怕一两次开支和劳军之后，再不能像从前那样的阔绰（chuò），原来他挥霍无度，超过以前的君王。

text_en: He was greatly perplexed in mind; then he determined to go to Persia and collect the revenues from those regions and raise a large fund.
text_cn: 因此心烦意乱，便决意到波斯去向各地征收捐税，大量聚敛银钱。

text_en: He left Lysias, a distinguished man of royal lineage, in charge of the king’s affairs from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt.
text_cn: 遂留下王族出身的贵人里息雅，托他代理从幼发拉的河直到埃及境界的国政；

text_en: Lysias was also to take care of his son Antiochus until he returned.
text_cn: 还托他抚育自己的儿子安提约古， 直到自己回来。

text_en: And he turned over to Lysias half of his forces and the elephants, and gave him orders about all that he wanted done. As for the residents of Judea and Jerusalem,
text_cn: 又将一半的兵力和象队交给他，吩咐他执行自己所决定的一切，尤其是关于犹太和耶路撒冷居民的事；

text_en: Lysias was to send a force against them to wipe out and destroy the strength of Israel and the remnant of Jerusalem; he was to banish the memory of them from the place,
text_cn: 即要他派遣军队攻打以色列，粉碎他们的力量，扫荡耶路撒冷剩余的居民，将他们的纪念，由那地上除去；

text_en: settle aliens in all their territory, and distribute their land by lot.
text_cn: 使外方人移居于他们的全境，将他们的土地拈(niān）阄（jiū）分给那些人为产业。

text_en: Then the king took the remaining half of his forces and left Antioch his capital in the one hundred and forty-seventh year. He crossed the Euphrates river and went through the upper provinces.
text_cn: 然后，王自己带着其余一半军队，在一四七年， 由国都安提约基雅出发，渡过幼发拉的河，向高原进发。

text_en: Lysias chose Ptolemy son of Dorymenes, and Nicanor and Gorgias, able men among the Friends of the king,
text_cn: 里息雅选派了多黎默乃的儿子仆托肋米、尼加诺尔和哥尔基雅，他们都是国王朋友中最有权势的人。

text_en: and sent with them forty thousand infantry and seven thousand cavalry to go into the land of Judah and destroy it, as the king had commanded.
text_cn: 又特派步兵四万和骑兵七千，由他们率领出征犹太地，照国王的命令摧毁那地。

text_en: So they set out with their entire force, and when they arrived they encamped near Emmaus in the plain.
text_cn: 于是他们便率领军队出发，到达靠近厄玛乌的平原上扎了营。

text_en: When the traders of the region heard what was said to them, they took silver and gold in immense amounts, and fetters, and went to the camp to get the Israelites for slaves. And forces from Syria and the land of the Philistines joined with them.
text_cn: 那一带的商人听说他们来了，就带着许多金银和脚镣，来到营幕，准备收买以色列子民为奴；依杜默雅和培肋舍特的军队，也来参战。

text_en: Now Judas and his brothers saw that misfortunes had increased and that the forces were encamped in their territory. They also learned what the king had commanded to do to the people to cause their final destruction.
text_cn: 犹大和他的兄弟见形势危急，敌军已在自己境内扎营；又听说王已下令，要根除自己的百姓，

text_en: But they said to one another, “Let us restore the ruins of our people, and fight for our people and the sanctuary. ”
text_cn: 就彼此说：“我们要挽救百姓免于灭亡，要为百姓及圣所而战。”

text_en: So the congregation assembled to be ready for battle, and to pray and ask for mercy and compassion.
text_cn: 于是集合会众，准备应战，且举行祈祷，恳求仁慈和怜悯。

text_en: Jerusalem was uninhabited like a wilderness; not one of her children went in or out. The sanctuary was trampled down, and aliens held the citadel; it was a lodging place for the Gentiles. Joy was taken from Jacob; the flute and the harp ceased to play.
text_cn: 这时，耶路撒冷好似无人居住的旷野，城中已没有一人出入；圣所已被人践踏，城堡已为外方人占据，成了异民的居所；雅各伯家不再欢乐，琴瑟之声业已止息，

text_en: Then they gathered together and went to Mizpah, opposite Jerusalem, because Israel formerly had a place of prayer in Mizpah.
text_cn: 于是以色列人集合起来，只有来到耶路撒冷对面的米兹帕；米兹帕原是以色列人昔日祈祷的圣地。

text_en: They fasted that day, put on sackcloth and sprinkled ashes on their heads, and tore their clothes.
text_cn: 那天人人禁食，身穿苦衣，头上撒灰，撕裂衣服，

text_en: And they opened the book of the law to inquire into those matters about which the Gentiles consulted the likenesses of their gods.
text_cn: 揭开《法律书》寻问，如同异民寻问他们的偶像一般。

text_en: They also brought the vestments of the priesthood and the first fruits and the tithes, and they stirred up the nazirites who had completed their days;
text_cn: 他们又带来司祭的衣服、初熟的果实和什一的献仪，并叫满期的“纳齐尔”人前来。

text_en: and they cried aloud to Heaven, saying, “What shall we do with these? Where shall we take them?
text_cn: 他们大声向上天呼号说：“我们对这些人当怎么办？要把他们带到何处？

text_en: Your sanctuary is trampled down and profaned, and your priests mourn in humiliation.
text_cn: 你的圣所已被践踏污辱；你的司祭已蒙难而忧伤。

text_en: Here the Gentiles are assembled against us to destroy us; you know what they plot against us.
text_cn: 异民齐来攻击，要消灭我们！你知道他们对我们所想的是什么。

text_en: How will we be able to withstand them, if you do not help us? ”
text_cn: 除非你援助我们，我们怎能抵抗他们？”

text_en: Then they sounded the trumpets and gave a loud shout.
text_cn: 他们遂吹号角，大声呼喊。

text_en: After this Judas appointed leaders of the people, in charge of thousands and hundreds and fifties and tens.
text_cn: 此后，犹大派定率领军人的千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长和十夫长；

text_en: Those who were building houses, or were about to be married, or were planting a vineyard, or were fainthearted, he told to go home again, according to the law.
text_cn: 又向修房屋、订婚、种葡萄与胆怯（qiè）的人说明，按法律他们可以各回本家。

text_en: Then the army marched out and encamped to the south of Emmaus.
text_cn: 于是调动军队，在厄玛乌以南安营。

text_en: And Judas said, “Arm yourselves and be courageous. Be ready early in the morning to fight with these Gentiles who have assembled against us to destroy us and our sanctuary.
text_cn: 犹大向他们说：“你们应装备起来，作勇敢的士兵，应准备停当，明早向前来攻击我们，毁灭我们和圣所的异民作战，

text_en: It is better for us to die in battle than to see the misfortunes of our nation and of the sanctuary.
text_cn: 因为我们在阵上，宁愿死，也不愿看见我们的民族与圣所遭遇不幸。

text_en: But as his will in heaven may be, so shall he do. ”
text_cn: 上天的旨意怎样，就怎样实行罢！”
